findings.reason: the section's whole evidence trail is reached through this one link, and pointing it correctly to the landed record (absolute path plus the `#s8-session-end` fragment) is a one-line content change a build node should not carry.
findings.text: the s8 landed summary links its "full record" to the bare href `s8-session-end`, which is the id of a `<section id="s8-session-end">` inside docs/evidence/archive/a-follower-lives-as-long-as-its-session-landed.html; the surface fetches `/<project>/s8-session-end.html`, and no file named `s8-session-end.html` exists anywhere in docs/, so the link a reader clicks to reach the live-proof evidence is dead — the sibling landed summaries on s3–s7 all link to absolute fragment files, so this is not the house convention

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the s8 landed summary's "full record" href does not resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — s10 names a negative control ("fails on the current code with `watcher-required`") and s11 names one for each of its two tests ("current code writes neither field"); both are measurably falsifiable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both sections put their gates in the repository's own test files (`tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py`, `tests/test_session_host.py`), which survive the run; no scratchpad or node-local temp path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the two new sections name test modules by what they test; no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — s10's stated cause matches the code path (the dry run calls `plan_dispatch`, which never reaches `_ask_session_host_for_follower`, so it refuses before the host is asked), and s11's mechanism runs on the real stop path (`SessionHost.stop` is the finally-called terminator that already performs the final `_write_record(force=True)`).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — s10 carries one deliverable (a dry run that predicts host delivery without writing the FIFO) and s11 carries one (the host's final record carries a stop time and reason).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan's `plan-depends-on` names `a-follower-outlives-its-monitor`, which resolves (docs/plans/a-follower-outlives-its-monitor.html, status shipped); no informs/gates edge is declared and none is owed, so no relationship points at the wrong node.
